details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) One specific workflow or pipeline phase (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate). Name it in your answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A specific script or helper under `scripts/`. Name the file.
C) Documentation only (README.md, `docs/`, or an agents.d fragment).
D) Something else. Describe it in your answer.
Q2: What problem should the change fix?
Choices:
A) A bug or a failure that keeps coming back. Give a run ID, error text or steps to reproduce it. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Cost or speed: fewer Actions runs, less runner time, fewer tokens or GitHub API calls.
C) A new capability or behaviour. Describe what it should do.
D) Readability or maintainability, with the current behaviour left exactly as it is.
Q3: How should we judge that the work is finished?
Choices:
A) A specific, observable result you state in your answer, such as a named failure no longer happening or a check passing. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A number you can measure, such as a percentage or count reduction you state in your answer.
C) No set target. The plan phase proposes how to judge it and you approve that before implementation starts.
